rules.description: Creation needs a primary guest, an assigned room, an active source and valid stay.
Hourly charges are package totals; nightly charges are base rate times configured nights.
Hotel timestamps use Asia/Manila; hourly timestamps preserve minute precision.
Operational blocks and overlapping confirmed stays prevent assignment; touching endpoints do not overlap.
Checked-in stays and cancelled occupancy locks block assignment independently of scheduled end.
Check-in requires a confirmed/reserved record, all rooms clean/active/operational, and now inside each scheduled window.
Checkout changes all assigned rooms to Dirty, releases occupancy and saves actual timestamps/audit.
Cancellation releases a future booking; occupied cancellation retains locks until departure unless vacated.
No-show requires confirmed/reserved and now at/after scheduled arrival; it releases availability.
Unrelated edits preserve captured prices, dates, actual timestamps, labels and audit. Explicit duration edits resolve current rates.
Room-type defaults are replaced on assignment changes; manual inclusions survive; shared positive overrides survive. Zero inherited defaults are restored on switching type.
Reservation inclusions clamp to nonnegative integers. Room-type defaults require positive integer quantities and unique products.
Purchases use active sellable ordinary products; extras use extra products; positive whole quantities, captured unit price, billed once.
Nightly breakfast allows one zero-priced meal/beverage pair per adult/child per service date; hourly has none. Stay/guest edits trim entitlement.
Final prices apply first, room/item reductions next, reservation reductions last; percentages use remaining eligible balance; fixed discounts cap at that balance.
Presets match stable room/product/rate/currency; incompatible selections warn and block save; same nightly rate survives night-count changes.
Manual room discount includes room charges; preset room discount covers accommodation only; item discount targets one line.
Manual discounts must be >0; percentages <=100. Reservation presets apply explicitly and cannot be duplicated.
Signed nonzero adjustments require a reason; total charges cannot be negative; money rounds by currency precision.
Historical disabled options remain readable and retained on unchanged records, unavailable for new selection.
Source selection captures an agreement by booking-entry hotel date and never marks collection received. OTA references may be required.
One permitted external accommodation total replaces discounted accommodation once; extras retain discounts; reason required when configured.
Financial decimal inputs reject negative, overflow, excess precision and nonnumeric values; new values use exact minor units.
Verified collection is append-only with evidence; refund/reversal cannot exceed collection; signed guest balance permits credit.
Commission estimates, documented liability, expected settlement and actual payout are separate and never reduce guest charges.
Settlement allocations retain channel/currency attribution and sum exactly; reconciliation requires an explanation and audit.
Source changes require review, preserve previous terms/collection/confirmations, and retain historical collection in guest balance.
Calendar distinguishes reserved/occupied/overdue/vacant; checked-in is overdue strictly after checkout; inactive visibility is optional.
Details and both print layouts consume saved billing; guest print excludes accounting controls.
All data is session memory and reload resets changes; no backend/authentication/bank integration/tax computation exists.
Guest creation requires a trimmed name; phone/email are optional.
Lifecycle actions and edits append readable, timestamped audit history.
Capabilities gate accounting domain actions; published agreements cannot rewrite financial rules; active ranges cannot overlap.
Physical room capacity override, description and operational notes are optional; blanks must permit other room configuration changes.

limitations: UI tests exercise the actual React/Vite app. All business records and financial transactions are simulated frontend session memory, not persisted or externally verified.
Chromium desktop, Asia/Manila, single property only. No claims for other browsers, mobile layouts, accessibility completeness, production authentication, or backend concurrency.
Explicit documented rules provide independent expected arithmetic. Source-only behavior is labeled an implementation contract and can still represent a product defect.

No full Cartesian product: all 18 monetary rate cells are tested; selected boundary/equivalence partitions and high-risk interactions cover the rest. No formal pairwise coverage claim for all dimensions.
Unsupported workflows and pending scenarios are counted separately, with reasons. Passing the implemented batch never means complete booking coverage.

Unclear policies: guest capacity/fractional counts, contact validation, no-show grace period, cancellation refunds, permitted overpayment policy, tax basis and reconciliation evidence need business review.
No existing on-demand Playwright utility or dependency was present in the repository; this isolated utility supplies that missing infrastructure without editing application logic.
